## Featured Projects

- [NelSync AI](https://sahayasavari.dev/projects/nelsync-ai): Smart Paddy Procurement Optimization system. 1st Place Overall Champion @ AIxcelerate 2026 Hackathon.
- [VibeCraft 2026 (NeuraGenZers)](https://sahayasavari.dev/projects/vibecraft-2026): Winner (5th of 110 teams) @ SRM IST Trichy YUVA'26. Dual campus web applications combining attendance projection and smart room location. Live at https://neuragenzers.vercel.app/
- [PrepMind AI](https://sahayasavari.dev/projects/prepmind-ai): Adaptive technical interview readiness and quiz platform built with Python, FastAPI, Supabase, and React (In Development).
- [Daily Spark](https://sahayasavari.dev/projects/daily-spark): Offline-first habit and streak tracking application built with React, TypeScript, and IndexedDB.
- [Portfolio Website](https://sahayasavari.dev/projects/portfolio-website): High-performance portfolio built with React 19, Vite, and hardware-accelerated animations.
